evidence.reason: `createStepFetch` unconditionally supplies its own undici `Agent` as the per-request dispatcher, and because `dispatcher` is set after spreading `init`, it overrides both any caller-supplied dispatcher and undici's global dispatcher. An operator who configured `setGlobalDispatcher(new ProxyAgent(...))` would have provider requests bypass the proxy and fail in a proxy-only environment. This is an implementation defect in the fetch wrapper, not merely a missing contract clause.
